# mondoo_integration_crowdstrike (Resource)

CrowdStrike Falcon for Cloud integration. Create it in a Mondoo organization (`org_id`), whose asset routing rules place the assets into spaces, or in a space (`space_id`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "client_id" {
  description = "The Client ID"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "client_secret" {
  description = "The Client Secret"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "cloud" {
  description = "The Falcon Cloud to connect"
  type        = string
}

provider "mondoo" {
  space = "hungry-poet-123456"
}

# Set up the CrowdStrike integration
resource "mondoo_integration_crowdstrike" "crowdstrike_integration" {
  name          = "CrowdStrike Integration"
  client_id     = var.client_id
  client_secret = var.client_secret
  cloud         = var.cloud

  # Optional: also import Falcon alerts and quarantined files (needs the
  # Alerts: Read and Quarantined Files: Read API scopes). Spotlight
  # vulnerabilities are always imported.
  finding_types = ["VULNERABILITY", "THREAT"]

  # Optional: import only these severities. Omit or leave empty for all.
  severities = ["CRITICAL", "HIGH"]

  # Optional: import only hosts that belong to these Falcon host groups (host
  # group IDs, 32 hexadecimal characters each). Omit or leave empty for all.
  import_host_groups = ["0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"]
}
```

```terraform
# Create the integrations in the Mondoo organization instead of a space: one per
# Falcon tenant (CID). At organization scope the integration imports findings
# only; it does not run fleet scans. The API creates no routing rule: the
# organization's asset routing rules place each imported host into a space, and
# findings for a host no rule matches are not imported.

variable "falcon_eu_client_id" {
  description = "The Client ID of the EU Falcon tenant"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "falcon_eu_client_secret" {
  description = "The Client Secret of the EU Falcon tenant"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "falcon_us_client_id" {
  description = "The Client ID of the US Falcon tenant"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "falcon_us_client_secret" {
  description = "The Client Secret of the US Falcon tenant"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

provider "mondoo" {}

resource "mondoo_integration_crowdstrike" "eu" {
  org_id        = "your-org-1234567"
  name          = "CrowdStrike EU"
  client_id     = var.falcon_eu_client_id
  client_secret = var.falcon_eu_client_secret
  cloud         = "eu-1"
}

resource "mondoo_integration_crowdstrike" "us" {
  org_id        = "your-org-1234567"
  name          = "CrowdStrike US"
  client_id     = var.falcon_us_client_id
  client_secret = var.falcon_us_client_secret
  cloud         = "us-1"
}

# Route each tenant's hosts into its own space
resource "mondoo_asset_routing_rule" "crowdstrike_eu" {
  org_mrn          = "//captain.api.mondoo.app/organizations/your-org-1234567"
  target_space_mrn = "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/hungry-poet-123456"
  priority         = 10

  condition {
    field    = "LABEL"
    operator = "EQUAL"
    key      = "mondoo.com/integration-mrn"
    values   = [mondoo_integration_crowdstrike.eu.mrn]
  }
}

resource "mondoo_asset_routing_rule" "crowdstrike_us" {
  org_mrn          = "//captain.api.mondoo.app/organizations/your-org-1234567"
  target_space_mrn = "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/happy-coder-654321"
  priority         = 10

  condition {
    field    = "LABEL"
    operator = "EQUAL"
    key      = "mondoo.com/integration-mrn"
    values   = [mondoo_integration_crowdstrike.us.mrn]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) Client ID used for authentication with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret used for authentication with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform.
- `name` (String) Name of the integration.

### Optional

- `cloud` (String) The Falcon Cloud to connect to.
- `finding_types` (Set of String) Kinds of findings to import besides Spotlight vulnerabilities, which are always imported. Add `THREAT` to import Falcon endpoint alerts and quarantined files; the API client then needs the `Alerts: Read` and `Quarantined Files: Read` scopes. Allowed values: `VULNERABILITY`, `THREAT`. Omit it to keep what is stored (vulnerabilities only on a new integration); set it to `[]` to go back to vulnerabilities only.
- `import_host_groups` (Set of String) Import only hosts that belong to these Falcon host groups, given as host group IDs (32 hexadecimal characters, at most 100). Empty imports hosts of every group. The API stores the IDs in lowercase. Omit it to keep what is stored (every group on a new integration); set it to `[]` to import every host group again.
- `member_cid` (String) CID selector for cases when the client ID and secret have access to multiple CIDs.
- `org_id` (String) Mondoo organization identifier. Set this to create the integration in the organization. Conflicts with `space_id`.
- `severities` (Set of String) Import only findings of these severities. Allowed values: `CRITICAL`, `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `LOW`, `INFORMATIONAL`. Empty imports every severity, and a finding whose severity CrowdStrike does not state is always imported. Narrowing it closes the Spotlight vulnerabilities it now excludes at the next import; alerts and quarantined files it excludes keep their last imported state. Omit it to keep what is stored (every severity on a new integration); set it to `[]` to import every severity again.
- `space_id` (String) Mondoo space identifier. If neither `space_id` nor `org_id` is set, the provider space is used.

### Read-Only

- `mrn` (String) Integration identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using integration MRN.
terraform import mondoo_integration_crowdstrike.crowdstrike_integration "//captain.api.mondoo.app/spaces/hungry-poet-123456/integrations/2Abd08lk860"
```
